1: Mass persisted despite two courses of antibiotics for presumed postoperative cellulitis
2: CT scan finding: soft-tissue thickening of anterior-inferior orbital rim and lower eyelid without extension into surrounding structures or bony invasion
Nodule remained stable in size three months after surgery
4: Final histopathology: granulomatous inflammation with central necrobiosis, extensive Alcian-Blue positive mucin, and scattered multinucleated giant cells
